changelog: FIX: Player on-screen options (Audio / Subtitles / Speed / Aspect / Sleep / Info) — the D-pad now actually moves focus inside the menu instead of toggling channels or seeking in the background. The first option is auto-focused on open so OK selects it immediately, and sub-panes (Audio track list, Subtitles, Aspect ratio, Speed, Sleep timer) also auto-focus their first row.
FIX: Settings → 'My HushTV Canada License' subtitle now correctly shows $50 CAD / year (was stale $40 text).
FIX: Discovery hero shows hi-res TMDB backdrops again — fallback chain when TMDB's /trending cache misbehaves.
FIX: Parental Controls hide locked categories across Live TV, Movies, Series, and Search.
FIX: Speed Test screen fits on smaller TVs.
NEW: 72-hour free trial for first-time Canada users.
